summary: Ramaco Resources filed an 8-K under Items 8.01/9.01 disclosing a jury verdict in the Hayseeds portion of its long-running West Virginia insurance-coverage litigation against Federal Insurance Company and ACE American Insurance Company over a 2018 partial silo collapse at its Elk Creek preparation plant. The excerpt recounts procedural history, including a 2021 jury award later reduced and Hayseeds damages vacated. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. This is ordinary litigation disclosure, not a special situation; watch for appellate outcomes and any insurance recovery impact on liquidity.
